scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-name engine && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./pkg/package.json','utf8'));p.name='@kikorin/engine-wasm';fs.writeFileSync('./pkg/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));fs.writeFileSync('./pkg/.gitignore','');fs.copyFileSync('./pkg/engine_bg.wasm','../../apps/web/public/engine_bg.wasm')"
scripts.dev: wasm-pack build --target bundler --profiling --out-name engine && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./pkg/package.json','utf8'));p.name='@kikorin/engine-wasm';fs.writeFileSync('./pkg/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));fs.writeFileSync('./pkg/.gitignore','');fs.copyFileSync('./pkg/engine_bg.wasm','../../apps/web/public/engine_bg.wasm')"
